Rule.name: HR CSV - Setup Identity Mappings
Rule.Description:
One-time setup rule. Adds the HR Authoritative CSV identity mappings to the EXISTING Identity ObjectConfig without replacing anything else in it. Safe to run more than once: a mapping that already exists is skipped.
Also creates the "status" identity attribute (PreHire / Active / Terminated), calculated by the global rule "HR Lifecycle - Status Attribute", and sets "displayName" to be calculated by the global rule "HR CSV - Display Name" ("firstName lastName" from HR), with a sync target to the LDAP ApacheDS account attribute "displayName" (pushed by an identity refresh with "Synchronize attributes" on).
Also maps the identity "email" from the LDAP ApacheDS account attribute "mail" (the address generated by the LDAP Create Account policy).
Run it from the IIQ console: rule "HR CSV - Setup Identity Mappings" or from Debug > Rule > Run. Import the Application and rules first.
